content: We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer) for the template that when applied to the molecule (provided as available input data) reproduces the reaction: TMSOTf protecting alcohols to TMS ethers. The forward reaction: alcohol + TMSOTf + base -> TMS ether. In retrosynthesis, we break O-Si bond and form O-H? Actually retrosynthetic step: target is TMS ether, we go back to alcohol. The template should involve breaking O-Si bond (trimethylsilyl) and forming O-H (hydroxyl). Functional groups broken: 'trimethylsilyl' maybe? The hint says broken is aliphatic hydroxyls? Wait description: "most notable broken is 'aliphatic hydroxyls'." That seems odd: In forward reaction, O-H bond broken (hydroxyl) and O-Si formed. So in retrosynthesis, we break O-Si and form O-H. So functional_groups_broken forward = aliphatic hydroxyls, formed = trimethylsilyl. We attempted search with those criteria and got empty. Maybe need to search with bonds broken/formed? The O-Si bond broken, O-Si formed? Actually forward: O-H broken, O-Si formed. So broken functional group aliphatic hydroxyls, formed trimethylsilyl. Search gave empty. Maybe need to search with bonds broken/formed: bond broken "O-Si"? Not sure format. Bonds are specified as atomic numbers? Eg "6-8"? O is atomic number 8, Si is 14. So bond broken "8-14". bond formed "8-14"? Actually forward forms O-Si, so bond formed "8-14". Broken O-H: "8-1". Let's try search with bonds.
